instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: npm install lucide-react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
2. SETUP FONTS: Add Playfair Display and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
3. IMPLEMENT THEME: Use the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' palette. Background #F4F4F0 is critical - do not use pure white for page bg.
4. BUILD SECTIONS: Create separate components for Hero, UniversityGrid, VideoGallery, ServicesList, ContactSection.
5. VIDEO GRID: Use a 7-item grid. First item full width or large, others in grid. Use placeholder YouTube embeds if IDs aren't provided, but structure them beautifully.
6. MAP: Use an iframe for the Google Map with the address 'Vasavi Mpm Grand, Ameerpet, Hyderabad'. Style it with grayscale filter if possible for 'Swiss' look.
7. BOOKING LINK: The 'Book Slot' button must link to 'https://bookings.edu9.in/#/2026' in a new tab.
8. FOOTER: Simple, clean, with the contact details and copyright.
9. ANIMATION: Use framer-motion for subtle entry animations (fade-up) on scroll. No aggressive bouncing.
10. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all buttons and links.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
No gradients. Flat colors + Texture (optional noise).
Typography is the hero. Ensure high contrast.
Interactive elements must have clear hover states.
